notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
The creature dies, triggering Liliana, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
